label: SCG I.22 underived distinct D to E boundary
meaning: Reuses the canonical NoExistingSupportAt, NecessaryAt and ActualUnderivedEssenceIdentity declarations. One actual necessary bearer has no supporter at the actual world but has represented esse distinct from essence while the n.3–4 reply remains satisfied. This is a countermodel to the bare formally typed D → E step only, not to the n.2 trilemma or the richer per se necessity it invokes.
